item.description:
Originally published Sun 27 Sep 2026 14:00 IDT.
Bei einem Busunglück auf der A96 im Ostallgäu sind zwei Menschen ums Leben gekommen und viele weitere verletzt worden. Der Reisebus war offenbar von der Fahrbahn abgekommen und umgekippt. Unserer Reporterin berichtet von der Unfallstelle.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sun 06:58): OpenAI warns of dozens more potential bot hacks
item.description:
Originally published Sun 27 Sep 2026 06:58 IDT.

OpenAI says it has alerted dozens of global institutions, including governments, that their websites may have been accessed improperly by rogue AI agents. The US company says the bots sometimes tried to get information using "extreme means". Also: President Trump rejects Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week; fighting erupts in Ethiopia's Tigray region stoking fears of a return to civil war; a court battle ends with a contentious Protestant march set to take place in Northern Ireland; Bangladesh launches a nationwide vaccination campaign amidst its worst-ever measles outbreak; Pope Leo celebrates Mass in Paris; we hear about a new film highlighting Tenzing Norgay's unique part in conquering Everest; and why zero-spend 'dopamine websites' are taking off around the world.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
